launches.title: Anana: AI Workspace for Hospitality Commercial Teams
launches.tagline: Use the demand signals inside of guest interactions to drive more direct bookings.
launches.body:
**TL;DR**\
Hotels rarely see what guests wanted before they booked or why they didn't book at all. Anana captures the demand signals buried inside calls, chats, and emails, completing the commercial picture with the intent and friction that transaction data misses.\
\
<https://youtu.be/OxO4FR-M7lI>

## Problem

Hotels are good at measuring outcomes: bookings, revenue, channel mix, and occupancy.

But the signals that explain those outcomes are buried across thousands of guest interactions. A family asks about connecting rooms and books elsewhere. Early check-in questions suddenly double. A repeat guest mentions an anniversary.

At scale, these are commercial signals. They reveal where direct demand is breaking down, what guests repeatedly want, and where hotels can personalize, convert, or win guests back.

Most hotels have no practical way to analyze this information at scale, so the insights disappear and their dependence on third-party distribution continues.

## Solution

Anana turns these signals into a commercial intelligence layer that hotels can analyze alongside booking and operational data.

Commercial teams can see where direct demand is being lost, which guest needs and segments are emerging, and what is driving conversion. Anana then reuses that intelligence across workflows—from improving marketing and the direct booking experience to identifying revenue opportunities and personalizing a guest’s stay.

Every guest interaction becomes an input into the next commercial decision.

## Our ask

We're looking to meet hotel owners, operators, and commercial leaders at multi-property hotel groups—particularly teams responsible for revenue, marketing, distribution, reservations, or commercial strategy.\
\
